name: Nullharbor
notes: Windows portable .exe launcher (Electron) bundles the same dist/ web game as Pages and the Android APK.

Tag windows-v* / v*-windows runs Windows Release CI on windows-latest and uploads Nullharbor.exe plus nullharbor-X.Y.Z-win.exe. Those releases set make_latest false so /releases/latest/download/Nullharbor.apk stays the newest Android APK.
Install app / PWA CTA is hidden in the desktop shell (NullharborDesktop) the same way the APK hides it (NullharborAndroid). Pages still shows Install.
HTTPS stays open for optional Supabase cloud sync. Game files are offline-bundled. Unsigned sideload — SmartScreen may warn. No in-app updater.

versionName 2.16.11 · Android versionCode stays 12 (this ship is the PC exe, not a new APK). Do not tag a Windows or Android Release until this PR is merged. Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.16.11. Save keys stay farbound-save-v2.
